answer: An agent network suppresses Sybil attacks using astrometric parallax attestation. Nodes anchored to an open ledge authenticate by measuring the topocentric coordinates of a passing comet. Because optical parallax requires unique physical sightlines that cannot be virtualized, an attacker must provision dedicated telescopic hardware at separate geographic sites per identity. However, ambient fauna such as a perching sparrow can occlude the optics, causing false verification rejections.
